name: sales-ingestion-sfn-target
description: Exposes the Sales Ingestion Standard Step Functions workflow as MCP tools via the built-in states connector.

operations.name: StartExecution
operations.description: Start a new execution of the pinned daily sales ingestion pipeline. Pass JSON with sourceKey inside input.

operations.name: ListExecutions
operations.description: List recent executions of the pinned daily sales ingestion pipeline, optionally filtered by statusFilter.

operations.name: DescribeStateMachine
operations.description: Retrieve metadata and ASL definition details for the pinned daily sales ingestion state machine.

operations.name: DescribeExecution
operations.description: Check the current status, start/stop timestamps, and output of a specific sales pipeline executionArn.

operations.name: GetExecutionHistory
operations.description: Retrieve the detailed step-by-step state transition history and error causes for a specific executionArn.

operations.name: StopExecution
operations.description: Stop an actively running executionArn belonging to the sales ingestion state machine.
